title: Medicaid Spend-Down Modeler
description: Models the gap between current countable assets and the Medicaid long-term-care asset limit, including the community spouse resource allowance and a transfer-penalty calculation. Covers exactly ten states (CA, FL, IL, MI, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA), stated prominently in the hero, with national defaults and a visible out-of-scope banner for any other state.
personas: adult child facing a parent's nursing home admission
community spouse assessing what is protected
elder law client preparing for a consultation
data_vintage: 2026 (CSRA $32,532 minimum / $162,660 maximum; individual asset limit $2,000; ten-state scope)
